description: This file defines the 'WorkShiftMenuConfigurator' class, which implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface to configure menu items related to 'workShift' in the OrangeHRM system's admin module.

classes.name: WorkShiftMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Class responsible for configuring the menu related to work shifts in the admin module.
